content.verseText: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
content.whyThisVerse: This verse speaks directly to peace — it's one of the passages LifeBook returns to most for that season.
content.meditation: Sit for a moment with "Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid." Let the words settle rather than rushing past them. Notice what in your day left you feeling peaceful.
content.reflectionQuestion: Where in the last day were you feeling peaceful, and what would it look like to bring that moment to God?
content.prayer: Lord, thank You for meeting me in how I actually feel today, not how I think I should feel. Help me carry John 14:27 with me. Amen.
content.actionStep: Send a one-line message to someone you trust, just to say hello.
